name: hackathonbsc-trading-dashboard
description: CMC + Trust Wallet trading dashboard for BSC

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:backend & pnpm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.deploy:testnet: cd contracts && hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network bscTestnet
scripts.deploy:mainnet: cd contracts && hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network bsc
